summary: Tested coupon/discount system: 20/20 backend pytest tests PASS (CRUD, validate, order integration, used_count increment, max_discount cap, case-insensitive, expired/inactive/usage_limit/min_order validation). Admin Dashboard Kuponlar UI verified end-to-end via Playwright (login -> tab -> create modal -> save -> row appears -> toggle Pasif Yap works). Checkout coupon UI section data-testids verified in code (coupon-input-section/input/apply-coupon-btn/applied-coupon/discount-line/remove-coupon-btn) but live e2e checkout coupon flow was blocked by inability to seed cart without real product purchase journey.

minor_notes.issue: Delete confirmation dialog (used by coupon delete) has no data-testid on Sil/Iptal buttons - reduces test automation reliability
Email/password Inputs and submit Button have no data-testid attributes (forces tests to use input[type=email] selectors)
Save useEffect on mount fires before any client code can seed localStorage post-load; not a user-facing bug but blocks programmatic cart seeding in e2e tests. Not a real bug for users.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='confirm-delete-btn' and data-testid='confirm-cancel-btn' to ConfirmDialog.jsx Sil/Iptal buttons for better test reliability
(Optional) Add data-testid to admin login email/password inputs and submit button
(Optional) Validate Checkout coupon flow end-to-end manually or via a Playwright test that adds a product through the homepage UI first
critical_code_review_comments: routes/coupons.py _validate_coupon_doc properly normalizes code via .strip().upper() - case-insensitive validation works
routes/orders.py increments used_count via $inc atomically AFTER validation - correct flow, no race for single-user
Discount calculation correctly caps max_discount and clamps to subtotal (won't exceed)
models/coupon.py CouponCreate uses field_validator to upper-case code on input, ensuring DB stores canonical form
Coupons exclude _id from responses (find_one with projection {'_id': 0}) - no MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue
Minor: routes/coupons.py POST /coupons returns 200 instead of 201 (REST convention) - functional but non-standard

Minor: get_current_user does not enforce role='admin' check - any authenticated user could currently call admin coupon endpoints. If only admins exist via register endpoint this is fine but should be hardened

success_rate.frontend: Admin CRUD UI verified (login/tab/create/toggle); Checkout coupon UI verified via code inspection only

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed coupons created and cleaned up by test fixtures (PCT*, FIX*, DUP*, VPCT*, VFIX*, VCAP*, INA*, EXP*, LIM*, ORD*, UPD*, DEL*). One UITEST{ts} coupon may remain from playwright test (toggle clicked, delete confirmation modal was not auto-confirmed due to no data-testid).

WELCOME10 coupon (10% percent, min_order=100) exists in DB as the seed coupon.
